elysiummobs.ability.blinding: Blinding: goes out taking your eyes with it.
elysiummobs.ability.bulwark: Bulwark: carries a field that rebuilds while it is not being spent.
elysiummobs.ability.cornered: Cornered: hits hardest when it is nearly finished.
elysiummobs.ability.echo: Echo: what one of them takes, the others feel.
elysiummobs.ability.hardened: Hardened: resists one kind of harm and suffers another.
elysiummobs.ability.knitting: Knitting: closes its own wounds. A slow fight is a losing one.
elysiummobs.ability.overcharged: Overcharged: answers a blow by getting worse.
elysiummobs.ability.standard: Standard: everything fighting near it fights better.
elysiummobs.ability.sundering: Sundering: strips the strength out of what it hits.
elysiummobs.ability.swift: Swift: covers ground you thought you had.
elysiummobs.ability.venomous: Venomous: leaves something in the wound.
elysiummobs.register.abandoned: The action was abandoned. The Empire found nothing worth pressing.
